title: Which way does the quantum world push a ball of light? A certified one-loop Bach source on the Evans-Coleman critical solution, and the sign of its secular push on the peak compactness
description:
In plain words. A collapsing ball of light (a gas of radiation) either forms a black hole or flies apart, and exactly on the dividing line sits the Evans-Coleman critical solution, which we certified earlier. Quantum fields add a small extra stress to it. Most of that stress depends on an unknown quantum state, but one slowly growing piece is fixed by the geometry alone: for every free massless field of spin up to 1 it is a positive multiple of a curvature quantity called the Bach tensor. We computed that piece on the certified solution with guaranteed error bars, and then the ball's response to it.

Results (computer-assisted). The energy profile of the Bach source is negative in the core and positive in the shell, with exactly one sign change on x in [-12, 12], at x in [-0.82611434347927570343, -0.82611433975398540497]. Its centre coefficient has the closed form c0 = -(2/3)W0(8W0-3)e^{-4xc} = [-173.1004443922995663248426 +- 8.79e-16]. The gauge-invariant s e^{2s} change of the local peak compactness 2m/r, at the sphere where the gas stands still, is Psi2 = [3.4616358037141656915 +- 3.02e-12] (per unit K eps s e^{2s}, Koike-Hara-Adachi clock, K = N_c/(30 pi)): positive, toward trapping. To our knowledge (search of arXiv, INSPIRE and Zenodo to 18 November 2026), no earlier work evaluates this source on a true critical solution, derives a sign from it, or certifies any semiclassical quantity on a true critical-collapse solution.

Not claimed. Every claim assumes a Hadamard quantum state respecting self-similarity, whose existence on this background is not proved. Which way Planck's constant moves the black-hole threshold is stated only as a conjecture under named conditions. The state-dependent part is not computed.

Checks. Five sealed tests, all listed: one HOLD and four FAILED by item. The headline held in all three bars that tested it, and the conservation-width bar failed and is reported as failed. Four internal hostile referee rounds (internal lab checks, not external peer review). A blind second implementation, by a different double-precision method, agrees to 6.9e-12 relative. A clean-room reproduction script re-runs the certificates.

Prepared with AI assistance; what was checked, and by what, is stated above.
